_comment: The built-in providers' addresses and the model each uses when a request names none. Data, not code: an operator overrides the DeepInfra model in settings.deepinfra.model or DEEPINFRA_MODEL, the OpenAI model in settings.openai.model, and the image address in settings.stabilityai.endpoint; any other provider is a connection in settings.ai.connections. Keys starting with _ are notes and are not read.

stabilityai._comment: Stable Diffusion 1.6 text-to-image, the built-in image generation when no connection is chosen for images.
